Added: The Winners Circle is here! After a free-for-all match, the camera introduces 3rd place, 2nd place, and then the champion before revealing the final results.
The top three players now celebrate on podiums using their selected character, color, and Victory Move. Official Classic champions also receive a Trophy-drop celebration.
Every player receives a personal results card showing placement, round wins, kills, disarms, XP, Gun Tokens, Trophies, and unlocked rewards.
Players can press Ready after reviewing the results. The host can return everyone to the lobby when the group is finished.
Beta Season progression is now active. Complete an Official Classic match to earn 20 to 100 XP based on placement and performance.
Official matches award 250 Gun Tokens for 1st place, 200 for 2nd, 150 for 3rd, and 100 for every other finishing player.
Your first Official Classic victory each day awards an extra 25 Season XP and 100 Gun Tokens. The bonus resets at midnight UTC.
The Level Road contains seasonal cosmetics and occasional Gun Token rewards. The Trophy Road contains exclusive rewards earned through Official Classic victories.
A new Progression screen shows your Season Level, Career Level, Prestige, XP, Trophies, Level Road, and Trophy Road.
Profiles now include season results, career statistics for each game mode, recent match history, and the Legacy Hall for completed seasons.

Fourteen animated dances have joined the Prize Counter: Backbeat Bounce, Champion Canter, Fresh Footwork, House Party Heat, Serpent Flow, Midnight Monster, Victory Wave, Breakspin Finale, Floorwork Finish, Birdie Boogie, Arena Clapline, Soul Cyclone, Quickstep Shuffle, and Victory Swing.
Ceremony March is available to everyone. Neon Victory, Western Toybox, Grand Arena, Pixel Champion, Champion Groove, and Deep Orbit can be purchased and equipped as Winners Circle themes.
Accounts now use a unique Account Name that is separate from the Display Name shown during matches. Account Names can be changed once every 14 days.
A new Female character model is available in the Locker with all 13 character colors and matching portraits.
Online chat is now available in lobbies, the Playpen, active matches, and spectator mode. Press T to open chat or Enter to begin typing.
A red damage indicator now shows the direction of incoming gunfire, and all six powerups have their own pickup icons.
Improved: The home screen is now divided into Play, Locker, Prize Counter, Progression, Profile, and Settings.
The Prize Counter now feels like a full arena shop with rotating shelves, item categories, rarity colors, favorites, affordability filters, and a larger item preview.
The Seasonal Starter Pool contains six items for the season and displays three items per page.
The Locker now shows only items you own. Character, weapon, dance, clothing, and audio items are organized into clearer categories.
Any owned animated dance can be equipped for the Winners Circle, a round victory, or both.
Dance previews now use your full character model in both the Prize Counter and Locker.
Equipped items can be unequipped directly. Reset Loadout restores the default equipment while keeping your chosen character model and color.
Outfits are now true bundles. Pieces you already own lower the bundle price, and purchased pieces can be equipped together or mixed with other clothing.
Your selected character, clothing, weapon skins, dances, and Winners Circle theme now follow you into online lobbies and matches.
The Profile screen has been redesigned as a competitor record hall with season progress, career stats, match history, Legacy Hall records, and account controls.
Match Settings now sorts maps alphabetically by default and includes a Newest sorting option. Online lobbies no longer begin with a bot already added.
Default One Gun and All Gun matches now use three-minute rounds, three round wins per set, and one set to win the match.
Winners Circle camera framing now keeps all podium characters and the complete background logo visible.
Twinkling background lights and redesigned result panels make the final standings easier to read without covering the podium scene.
A separate Ceremony Volume slider now controls Winners Circle music. Previewing a ceremony theme pauses the menu music so the tracks do not overlap.
Low, Medium, High, and Ultra settings now scale menus, map previews, gameplay effects, and the Winners Circle more consistently.
Original One Gun, Original Melee Finish, Hip Hop, Swing Dance, and Ceremony March now appear as permanently owned starter choices in the Locker.
Winners Circle results now stay open until every connected player is Ready or the host returns everyone to the lobby.

Holding Tab during a match now opens the Arena Matchboard, with clearer placement, round progress, kills, disarms, player status, match details, and markers for you, the host, and the current One Gun holder. The top five always stay visible, while the final row shows your true placement when you are 6th–10th.
Fixed: Signed-in accounts without a loaded name now display CLOUD PROFILE instead of Signed In Null.
Official Tailscale matches now correctly award XP and Gun Tokens to finishers and a Trophy to the champion.
Players who leave an Official match are marked DNF and receive no rewards. Players who stay can still finish and receive their full rewards.
When only one player remains in an Official match, that player now wins immediately by forfeit and receives their earned XP, 250 Gun Tokens, and one Trophy.
Typing in chat no longer moves your character or spectator camera.
Female character colors, portraits, animations, equipment, and online appearance now remain consistent.
Removed: Vampire Touch has been removed from powerup drops, Match Settings, saved presets, and the Playpen.
Misc: Private authenticated Tailscale matches count as full Official matches when they begin with at least three signed-in human players and use the approved Classic One Gun rules.
An Official match can still award rewards if only one or two players remain, as long as the match began with a qualifying roster.
Season Level, Season Prestige, Season XP, Trophies, and both reward roads reset every three months and are recorded in the Legacy Hall.
Career Level, Career Prestige, Gun Tokens, match statistics, and every purchased or earned cosmetic are permanent and never reset.
Cosmetics marked ART PENDING are safely owned by your account and will receive their final appearance in a later update.
The Winners Circle currently supports free-for-all One Gun and All Gun matches. Team modes and One of Us still use the previous ending screen.
